items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I played with Tony Amarica on the boat during the war too... And Abbey Brunish, the one that died, played drums.

ctx.x: What was he using Moe Zutikoff with, he had Brunis?
I can't understand that. I don't know. Well, he and Brunis were always at each other's throats. Never could get along together.
